headline: POTEMKIN SAILORS REVOLT: CREW SEIZES BATTLESHIP, OFFICERS THROWN OVERBOARD
dispatch: Sailors aboard the Imperial Russian battleship Potemkin seized control of the vessel in the Black Sea on June 27, 1905, killing several officers in a bloody mutiny that shocked the Tsar's navy. The men had refused rations of rotten meat and when officers threatened to shoot ringleaders, the crew rose up in open rebellion. The Potemkin then steamed toward Odessa, where strikes were already paralysing the port city.
answer: Crew of battleship Potemkin mutinies against officers, 1905
